import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router'; @Component({ selector: 'app-home-page', standalone: true, imports: [RouterLink], template: `
CampusFind
Home Login Register Dashboard

Find what you lost on campus

Smart item recovery and matching for KIIT students.

Create account Login

Lost & Found

Post missing items, discover likely matches, and report recoveries.

Campus matching

Rule-based matching by category, keywords, location, and date.

` }) export class HomePageComponent {}
